"The mDL is based on an international standard and all states are working towards that same standard. However, the mDL requires certain technology to be able to read and verify it. So while the mDL is valid in other states, just like a physical card, it is up to each business or verifier to decide whether or not to have mDL reader technologies available to customers, so keeping your physical card with you is still a good idea."

Is Arizona ID in Apple/Google/Samsung Wallet the Same as mID?
No. Arizona ID in Apple/Google/Samsung Wallet "can be presented to confirm identity"/"is one of the few IDs that can be presented" at select TSA airport security checkpoints to confirm your identity.
The Arizona Mobile ID can be used to remotely authenticate identity and complete enhanced-security services on AZMVDNow.gov, such as transferring a vehicle title. More information on the Arizona Mobile ID can be found here.

AirtableSource.title: Apple Wallet
AirtableSource.value:
You can use your Arizona ID in Apple Wallet on iPhone and Apple Watch at select TSA checkpoints and lanes at participating airports.
Additionally, you may present your Arizona ID in an app with your iPhone for participating apps.

AirtableSource.title: Google Wallet
AirtableSource.value: You can use your Arizona ID in Google Wallet at select TSA PreCheck® checkpoints and lanes at participating airports.

AirtableSource.title: Samsung Wallet
AirtableSource.value:
Currently, a Mobile Driver's License or State ID can only be used at select TSA checkpoints in select airports in participating states. Please visit the TSA Digital ID site for the most up to date information on TSA acceptance.
You should continue to carry your physical driver's license or State ID as a form of identification.

AirtableSource.value: Part of 2023 Digital Identity Framework - California DMV Wallet mobile driver’s license (mDL) pilot program. "The California Department of Technology (CDT) is responsible for the development, implementation, administration, and management of the California Digital ID Framework. The Framework is a collection of data, technology infrastructure, digital services, and gover­nance that allows for secure, user-friendly use of digital IDs across California. It ensures that everyone is held to the same high standards, better protecting your privacy, and helps you easily access more of California’s state programs and benefits by simplifying and streamlining eligibility verification across agencies."
